description: Turn monthly recurring revenue into annual recurring revenue (ARR = MRR x 12), with ARPU when the customer count is given and the months to $100k, $1M and $10M ARR at a monthly growth rate. Count annual plans at their yearly price divided by 12 and leave one-time fees out of MRR. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/arr-calculator

monthly_growth_pct.description: Expected MRR growth per month in percent, e.g. 8 (optional)

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in any currency

name: calculate_arr

months.description: 0 when reached, null when not within 20 years

title: Calculate ARR from MRR
